notes.title: Update 2 Patch 1 Released
notes.content:
A small patch for update 2 has been released.
This includes a couple of bug fixes and adjustments, including:
[list]
[*] Added option for asynchronous scene loading, which will fix load times, but may cause issues on lower end systems (particularly those running an HDD).
[*] Leaping will now ignore jumps [i]towards[/i] walls.
[*] Slightly adjusted the Foyer to make it more readable for new players.
[*] Fixed a few other bugs (input prompts are hopefully fixed now).
[/list]

Again, please post any issues or suggestions you may have on the community page or the Discord server.

Adios,
- WormyMaple

notes.title: Update 2 Is Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42562870/de3945543b235c11428ea60cdfb73e32e96397a6.png[/img][h2]Update 2 has finally arrived, after quite some time![/h2]

[h3]It adds lots of new things, including:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A new area - The Sound
[*] A new boss - The West Guardian
[*] A map
[*] Better controller support
[*] New music from [url=https://soundcloud.com/coldenperkins]margeant.sajor[/url] and I
[*] And much more!
[/list]

This update is a complete re-do of the game, with an entirely new backend. 99% percent of things that were previously in the game are still there, now with extra polish. With these new changes, the game should run, play, and look much better than it did before.

Have fun, and please report any issues or suggestions that you have on the community hub or Discord server!

Good Luck!
- WormyMaple

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
[b]Fixed Issues:[/b]
- Terminal now resets if spammed
- Cursor now hides when using controller
- Gate light sounds no longer conflict

[b]Known issues:[/b]
- Player can occasionally get stuck when switching input devices
- If a mouse is used while in a menu, a controller will no longer function
